thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: inference-service error_rate > 15% for 3m (rule: inference-service-error-rate). PagerDuty P2 triggered. PD: https://pd.example/INC-5421

maria: Taking this. Oncall here — I'll triage. Any customer-facing errors reported?

jonathan: Seeing a sharp 5xx spike from model-runtime pods after the 03:12 deploy. ~30% of requests failing for t=10m. No obvious backpressure on infra.

lee: I can check pod logs and restart the rollout if necessary. Also seeing increased tail latency on GPU nodes.

anya: Suggest we reduce alert noise first so PD doesn't keep paging for the same underlying issue. Proposal: temporary dedupe window 10m + rate-limit the alert to 1/5m, then create a dashboard.

maria: Agreed. Customer impact: internal monitoring shows degraded embeddings and chat timeouts; external API error rate ~1.2% of customer traffic (some retries). Not yet widespread, but noisy for oncall.

opsbot: Executing requested mute: `/alerts mute inference-service-error-rate --duration 600s --note "temp dedupe during triage"` :white_check_mark:

jonathan: Thx. While muted, I'll run a quick diff of the deploy and revert the model runtime change if logs point there. Can someone add a focused grafana panel for 5xx by model version?

lee: Adding panel now. Quick query I pushed to dashboard: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="model-runtime",status=~"5.."}[1m])) by (model_version)` - shows v3.2 spike.

anya: For alert tuning after incident: we should change the alert expression to include `unless increase(http_requests_total{status=~"5.."}[5m]) < 50` to avoid noisy small bursts, and add a grouping key on `model_version` so we don't page for every pod.

maria: Good; create a small remediation doc in the incident thread with action items. I'll handoff to jonathan in 25m.

jonathan: Will own post-triage and follow up with product on rollback if needed. Action items I noted: 1) revert deploy if root cause confirmed; 2) make alert dedupe permanent with 5-10m window; 3) add model_version grouping; 4) create a per-model error-rate dashboard and synthetic request job.

anya: I'll open a PR for alert rule change and add tests. Draft snippet I plan to submit:
```yaml
alert: InferenceHighErrorRate
expr: |
  sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="model-runtime",status=~"5.."}[5m])) by (model_version)
  > 50
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "High 5xx for {{ $labels.model_version }}"
```

lee: If PR lands, let's also add a runbook link and a debug panel showing recent deploys and gc/oom events.

maria: Handing off now — jonathan is the incident owner. I'll check back at EOD. Thanks team :thumbsup:

opsbot: Note: PD escalation suppressed while mute active. Remember to unmute or reconfigure rule after follow-up.

jonathan: Putting follow-ups in a ticket and assigning: `SRE-2388` (alert tuning + dashboard). I'll unmute after we ship the alert rule change.

maria: Leaving oncall in 15. If anything critical pops, page me again. Otherwise, continue in-thread updates. :pushpin:
